# Recreation Prompt

Build a single-file browser canvas game titled `Red Alley Rival: Tag the Ninja`. Preserve the source mechanic exactly: falling circular-hitbox entities spawn from the top, descend vertically, good entities tapped by a single pointer action award +10 and disappear, bad entities tapped cost one of three lives and disappear, missed good entities cost one life, score increases spawn pressure, and zero lives shows a game-over modal with a restart button. Rebuild all presentation as a deterministic red-black comic-street ninja rivalry: procedural rooftop alley background, large rival mask mural, graffiti/shuriken/spray-can good targets, skull decoy hazards, HUD labels `Clean Tags` and `Mask Cracks`, and mobile-safe comic UI using Bangers/Rajdhani fonts.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first reflex tap arcade / falling-object avoidance game
- objective: tap beneficial falling objects before they leave the screen while avoiding harmful ones
- input model: single pointer/tap on the canvas; restart uses native button click/tap
- core loop: spawn falling entities, update descent, player taps one entity or misses, update score/lives/feedback, ramp spawn pressure by score, continue until lives reach zero
- fail/friction state: good entities missed or bad entities tapped reduce lives; empty taps reset combo and warn; zero lives opens game-over modal

## Protected Mechanics
- Three lives, no win state, game-over at zero lives.
- Good tap gives +10 score and removes one entity.
- Bad tap costs one life and removes one entity.
- Good entity leaving the screen costs one life.
- Spawn timer, vertical falling movement, generous circular tap hit test, combo feedback, score-based difficulty multiplier, and restart reset are preserved.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD labels, title, modal copy, entity drawing, particles, background, palette, fonts, audio labels, feedback wording, and screenshot-facing presentation are safe to transform because they do not alter the protected loop.
